scope: One managed local HTTP review server per repository and host, shared by its Git worktrees. Document tooling only; no platform phase acceptance.
decision: Use an OS-owned lifetime lock plus private authenticated server state and a persisted port in the common Git directory. A port-only convention would allow duplicate servers on different ports; a PID file alone would permit unsafe stale-PID takeover.
shutdownPolicy: Explicit --stop, --restart or Ctrl+C in the owning terminal. Drain active HTTP connections and handler promises before releasing ownership. Do not infer shutdown from one tab closing, because other tabs or saves may remain active.

tests.environment: Native Windows Node; disposable Git repositories, worktrees, processes and local remotes

coverage: Concurrent and separate-process opens reuse one authenticated instance
Changing the requested port cannot bypass ownership
Git worktrees share the same server slot
Other checkouts/documents cannot silently stop or replace the owner
Private manager token and foreign-Origin rejection
Connected and disconnected note handlers finish before ownership release
Starting and unresponsive owners are unknown, not falsely inactive
Shutdown tracks its own instance even after immediate replacement
Crash recovery never terminates a recorded PID
Unknown listeners are neither killed nor bypassed automatically
Failed startup releases ownership; restart replaces rather than duplicates
Bound port persistence includes HTTP port 80
Case-insensitive Git redirect variables cannot redirect the launcher

liveVerification.browserNotesStatus: Repository notes loaded; original notes version retained as an earlier version
liveVerification.legacyMigration: Confirmed the user's saved-note status, then stopped the known owned legacy terminal session and started the managed replacement. No unknown process was terminated.

independentReview.result: Four production findings repaired and closed by source inspection. The remaining replacement-race test gap was closed with a controlled barrier and a passing focused regression. Parent ran the final 57-case suite.

limits: Native Windows is tested. Native POSIX operation and simultaneous Windows/WSL ownership are not qualified. Separate hosts maintain separate server instances. An explicit shutdown can wait for an unfinished handler; no forced takeover is performed.

repositoryPatternCheck.error: Review is stale or missing: inspect changes and refresh sourceDigest
repositoryPatternCheck.reason: Concurrent platform source, audit and delivery changes require their owning full review; this scoped document-tooling review does not accept them.
